macaque_snrna.selectedScope: This obese-versus-normal reanalysis uses the macaque hypothalamic single-nucleus data produced by Lei and colleagues. It includes source samples HCA_Macaque001_S001 through S006. S001 through S003 are Normal and S004 through S006 are Obese. The analysis treats each cell population separately, so retained sample counts can differ between populations.
macaque_snrna.limitations: The source publication describes the original study. The obese-versus-normal reanalysis shown here is separate and does not yet have its own publication.

mouse_hypo_hfd_gse220533.searchTopic: Mouse hypothalamus: WT HFD vs chow
mouse_hypo_hfd_gse220533.selectedScope: This comparison uses the wild-type chow and high-fat-diet samples from the GPR101 study to examine the diet effect within wild-type hypothalamus. It excludes the knockout arms in the deposited matrix.
mouse_hypo_hfd_gse220533.limitations: The available manuscript diet result pools genotypes, so it is not the same comparison as this wild-type-only analysis. Expression values retain the deposited log2-normalized scale.

mouse_arc_hfd_gse225038.searchTopic: Mouse arcuate nucleus: control HFD vs chow
mouse_arc_hfd_gse225038.selectedScope: This comparison uses control-genotype arcuate-nucleus samples under chow and high-fat diet. It excludes the source study's Klf4-deletion samples.

mouse_hypo_fasting_gse294478.selectedScope: This comparison examines whole-hypothalamus expression after 72 hours of fasting relative to fed controls. The experiment concerns negative energy balance, rather than diet-induced obesity.
mouse_hypo_fasting_gse294478.limitations: The authors deposited results for fed versus 24-hour fasting and 24-hour versus 72-hour fasting. Their adjacent effect estimates can support a reconstruction of the 72-hour-versus-fed effect. Their P values and FDR cannot be combined into significance values for this comparison.

mouse_hypo_overfeed_gse247825.selectedScope: The explorer estimates a common intragastric-overfeeding effect across days 14 and 17 in a model that includes day. The original publication reports the two days separately.
mouse_hypo_overfeed_gse247825.limitations: This pooled effect is an exploratory analysis. It should not be interpreted as either the day-14 or day-17 result from the publication.

mouse_hypo_hfd_tc_gse305719.searchTopic: Mouse hypothalamus: HFD day 0 vs 12 weeks
mouse_hypo_hfd_tc_gse305719.selectedScope: This comparison uses the day-0 baseline and the 12-week high-fat-diet samples from the deposited time course.
mouse_hypo_hfd_tc_gse305719.limitations: There is no chow-fed comparison arm in this analysis. The time-course difference should not be described as a matched HFD-versus-chow effect.

mouse_hypo_hfd_gse236077.selectedScope: The explorer includes the hypothalamus arm of the mouse brain RNA-seq atlas, comparing chow with 16 hours of high-fat-diet exposure. This track excludes the atlas's other brain regions.
mouse_hypo_hfd_gse236077.limitations: The short dietary exposure should be distinguished from the chronic high-fat-diet experiments elsewhere in the collection.

mouse_hypo_treg_gse282067.selectedScope: These data are the deposited BL/6 hypothalamic CD4+CD25+ regulatory T-cell pools under standard diet or high-fat diet. Each library pools cells from five mice.
mouse_hypo_treg_gse282067.limitations: The displayed sample counts refer to pooled libraries, not individual mice. This cohort differs from the pooled BALB/c Foxp3-GFP cohort displayed in the paper.

mouse_poa_fgf_gse285006.searchTopic: Mouse preoptic area: pooled dnFGFR effect
mouse_poa_fgf_gse285006.selectedScope: This analysis estimates the dominant-negative FGFR genotype effect across same-sex and opposite-sex housing. The authors instead compare housing conditions within each genotype.
mouse_poa_fgf_gse285006.limitations: The pooled genotype contrast is exploratory and answers a different question from the source publication's within-genotype housing contrasts.

mouse_pomc_maternal_hfd_gse135639.selectedScope: The POMC-neuron RiboTag data cover both maternal diets, chow and high-fat diet, at birth (P0) and weaning (P21). The explorer compares maternal diets at each age and P0-to-P21 maturation within each diet arm.
mouse_pomc_maternal_hfd_gse135639.limitations: The source study emphasizes maturation within each diet arm. Comparisons between maternal diets at a fixed age are explicitly exploratory reanalyses. Here, limma-trend refits the deposited normalized CPM values. That fit does not reproduce the source study's raw-count edgeR analysis.

mouse_hypo_spatial_aging_gse270383.selectedScope: For each independent female mouse, the analysis aggregates hypothalamic spatial profiles from sections 4 and 5. It compares 23 months with 4 months of age.
mouse_hypo_spatial_aging_gse270383.limitations: This reanalysis uses the deposited 2024 cohort of 128,405 profiles. It is not the final publication's revised 98,006-profile cohort. Individual spatial profiles are not independent animal replicates.

mouse_hypo_spatial_cr_gse273038.selectedScope: The data compare caloric restriction with ad libitum feeding in 24-month-old male mice. The analysis aggregates hypothalamic spatial profiles from two sections for each independent animal.
mouse_hypo_spatial_cr_gse273038.limitations: The analysis units are animals, rather than individual spatial profiles. This comparison concerns dietary restriction in aged males.

human_hypo_pituitary_organoid_gse301692.selectedScope: The data come from day-15 human iPSC-derived hypothalamus-pituitary organoid cultures. The comparison groups cultures by the study's machine-learning predictions of successful or unsuccessful differentiation. It excludes day-9 libraries to keep the sampled timepoint consistent.
human_hypo_pituitary_organoid_gse301692.limitations: The group labels describe predicted differentiation outcomes. This comparison uses cultured organoids, not human hypothalamic tissue. The source-count analysis shown here excludes two synthetic reporter rows.
